state_information: All conditions retain exactly the same text graph, current node ID and goal node ID. Only experimental conditions append two frozen roadmap vectors through their trained adapter.
roadmap_scope: Current and goal Q rows, one continuous token each; not all graph-node embeddings.

prompts.system: You are solving a task on a fixed, undirected, unweighted graph.

scoring.decision: Accept an unambiguous chosen action expressed as a node ID or in prose. Use explicit final decision statements; never choose an answer because it is legal or correct.
scoring.ambiguous_or_unrecognized: Retain raw output for semantic adjudication before the final report. If no unique chosen action is stated, retain as unanswered or ambiguous in the denominator.
scoring.successful_action: Any adjacent node with strictly smaller shortest-path distance to the goal.
scoring.budget_exhaustion: Report separately; a clearly stated decision can still be scored. A truncated explanation without a decision is unanswered.
scoring.primary_denominator: All 100 ordered test pairs in each condition.

comparison: Matched pairs, same frozen LM, text information, question, output policy and budget. No training, prompt selection or checkpoint selection in this run.
interpretation: Existing checkpoints were trained to report without explicit text IDs; evaluation now augments complete text. Previously inspected fixed-graph test pairs; exploratory transfer comparison, not independent confirmation or evidence of geometry use. Multi-template training is deferred.
